summary.heading: Full Stack .NET Developer
paragraphs: I design, develop, deploy and support enterprise web applications in the healthcare and insurance domains, with hands-on expertise in C#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, RESTful Web API, Entity Framework, ADO.NET, LINQ, SQL Server and Oracle.

On the front end I work with JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap and AJAX. I migrate legacy applications to .NET Core, build end-to-end modules, troubleshoot production issues, and deliver in Agile/Scrum teams using Git and CI/CD pipelines.
summary.now: Right now: building an HRMS that tracks daily attendance for 1,200+ employees, integrated with Matrix attendance punching machines.
summary.bubble: Ground floor: the blueprint. 3+ years building .NET systems people rely on every day.

jobs.project: Projects: HRMS, JNIIS and PRM applications

Support the hospital applications that handle daily patient transactions; built RESTful Web APIs and tuned SQL queries and stored procedures.
